title: 23rd sitting of the 20th Majlis

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/23/2024).

Question time: Galolhu North MP Mohamed Ibrahim asks Minister of Housing, Land and Urban Development Dr Ali Haidar Ahmed when plot boundaries will be marked and land handed over to those allocated land in Gulhifalhu, when plots given to Malé residents under the previous government's Binveriya scheme will be handed to their owners, and when the 4,000 flats under construction in Hulhumalé Phase 2 will be handed to successful applicants.
First reading of the Insurance Bill, submitted on behalf of the government by Mahibadhoo MP Ahmed Thoriq.
Report of the Public Finance Committee on its review of the Communications Authority of Maldives audit reports for 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019 and 2020.
Report of the Public Finance Committee on its review of the Family Protection Authority audit reports for 2014 and 2017 to 2023.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting questioned the housing minister on land and flat handovers, introduced the Insurance Bill and took up finance committee reports on two agencies' audit reports.
